user: A person working in a shared room beside an AI agent, and the agent working beside them.
problem: A human and an agent editing the same surface clobber each other, and the loser of the race finds out afterwards. README: 'without clobbering each other'.
wedge: Advisory presence, versioned compare-and-set, drafts and proposals, and short publish leases, so neither party silently overwrites the other.
primaryJob: Let a human and a NodeAgent edit the same spreadsheet, notebook or post-it surface at the same time without silent overwrite.
primaryArtifact: A live shared surface with per-room traces, where every write is versioned and every agent change arrives as a draft or proposal.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: It produces exactly the silent overwrite the room exists to prevent, and the loser cannot tell it happened.

rejectedAlternatives.alternative: Locking the surface for one editor at a time.
rejectedAlternatives.reason: It serialises collaboration; the product's premise is a human and an agent working beside each other, not in turns.

openUnknowns: Whether short publish leases are long enough for a human edit and short enough not to block the agent — the README describes a next lease layer, so the current one is not final.
The repository ships docs/GAPS_NOT_DONE.md, so the product itself declares work not done; those gaps are unknowns for this contract too.
successCondition: A human and an agent both complete work on the same surface in one session, and neither one's change is lost or silently replaced.

prohibited: publish a draft to the shared surface without a human
write outside a held publish lease

derivedFrom.source: noderoom/README.md (and docs/GAPS_NOT_DONE.md, which the product ships to declare its own gaps)
unverifiedFields: openUnknowns — partly from the product's own GAPS_NOT_DONE.md, partly judgement
rejectedAlternatives — inferred from the README's framing, not from a stated decision record
